title: Framer Review 2026: Pricing, Features, and Honest Verdict
summary: Framer produces some of the best-looking AI-generated sites tested, but it falls short on backend depth, portability, and non-designers. Here's why Blink is the more complete platform for serious builders.
body_markdown: For pure design and motion quality, Framer remains genuinely strong. For anything that needs a backend, a database, or real portability, Blink is the better alternative: a full backend, two-way GitHub sync, flat pricing, and a built-in SEO fix are all things Framer doesn't offer.
